headline: Fishermans Row Erupts Anew; Godcrofts Ruin Leaves the Map
war_summary: Since our last edition, the fighting has broken out afresh along Fishermans Row, where four base actions in the past two hours — fifteen in the day, Fort Ember the busiest post — sent losses on both sides leaping from near nothing to better than a hundred the hour, the latest action scarcely half an hour old. Tempest Island traded posts through the morning watch, sixteen movements about Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate, the latest at half past eight. Godcrofts has stirred around Lipsia, and the solitary ruin marked there has left the map, the hex now wholly Warden-kept. Farranac Coast's churn about Mara and Terra has slackened, without movement since four o'clock, and Lykos Isle's posts have been still since half past three, though losses there run past four hundred an hour on either side. The Dead Lands file no base report since late evening yet bleed past ten thousand Colonial and nearly fourteen thousand Warden in the day; the motionless Weathered Expanse still tops the butcher's bill at better than twenty-one and twenty-two thousand respectively, with Clahstra likewise bleeding without moving. The ledger stands at two hundred forty-three Colonial works to one hundred ninety-one Warden, none demolished. It is the war's hundred-and-thirteenth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
